Movie : Thokar (1974)
Music Director: Shyamji Ghanshyamji
Singer : Mukesh
Director: Dilip Bose
Main Dhoondta Hoon Jinko is a song from the 1974 movie Thokar starring Baldev Khosa, Alka, Tun Tun, Sunder, Jaginder, Mumtaz Begum, Sudhir, Jr Mehmood, Brahmachari, Rajan Haksar, Shiv Kumar, Maruti. The lyrics were penned by Sajan Dehlvi and Kulwant Jani. The film was directed by Dilip Bose.
